entries.claim: The containment check is still vulnerable to a TOCTOU swap: `inside(path)` resolves and validates the phase entry, but `planFilesIn(path)` subsequently reopens that pathname. An actor able to alter the planning tree can replace an in-root phase directory (or an in-root symlink target) with a symlink to an outside directory after the check and before this call; the later directory read follows the replacement and scans outside-root PLAN files. The same check-then-use pattern applies to a group between its `inside(dir)` check and subsequent reads, and a planning root reached through a symlink has the analogous pathname-rebinding race. Thus the locator can still be induced to walk a real path outside the planning root.
entries.failure_scenario: Start with `root/phases/1` as a real in-root directory so `inside(path)` returns true. Concurrently, after that check and before `planFilesIn(path)` performs its filesystem operations, rename `root/phases/1` aside and create `root/phases/1 -> /outside/1`, where `/outside/1/PLAN.md` exists. `planFilesIn(path)` follows the new link and reads the outside PLAN file.
